title: Puharich's theory in Beyond Telepathy of relaxed versus aroused states

tellings.quote: Puharic wrote about that in a book called beyond telepathy in in which he developed a theory that for receptive forms of ESP it's good to be relaxed

plain: Andrija Puharich, a researcher of the mind and the paranormal, set out a theory in his book Beyond Telepathy that the receptive kinds of ESP, such as picking up someone else's thoughts, work best when a person is relaxed, while other kinds suit a more aroused, keyed-up state. Jeffrey Mishlove, a guest with a PhD who studies psychics and the afterlife, tells Michels this as something he knows from the book. If true, it would mean psychic ability could be helped along by training the right state of mind.
